recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR-core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-5387 unless a future work-group decision changes the operations criteria; FHIR-28142 already supplied the later clarification now present in the same paragraph.
issue_request: FHIR-5387 was a Published FHIR-core Jan 2015 ballot change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking for clearer criteria for defining operations beyond the RESTful interaction set. The accepted resolution directed the operations page to say operations are used where the server actively formulates the response rather than merely returning existing information, or where the intended purpose is side effects such as modification or creation of resources.
initial_application: The issue was applied by commit 93f0d5532413ab675c739f8f400faea58d0e324a, '#5387: Text added on operations page', which matches the Jira application comment referencing SVN @6319 and added the requested active-response and side-effect wording to source/operations.html. Later commits reorganized that sentence into the current bullet list without losing the approved meaning.
additional_context: The active current source is source/operations.html, the operations framework page linked from RESTful API and OperationDefinition-related content. FHIR-28142 later clarified the side-effects bullet for R5, adding the current distinction for resources not transmitted as part of the RESTful call and other out-of-scope changes; this refines rather than conflicts with FHIR-5387. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant FHIR-5387 discussion or conflicting guidance.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/operations.html already says operations are appropriately used when the server needs to play an active role in formulating the response and when the intended purpose is side effects, including modification or creation of resources not transmitted as part of the RESTful call or other changes outside the RESTful interface.

related_jiras.note: Published R5 clarification of the same side-effects bullet, confirming the current wording is a deliberate refinement rather than a conflict with FHIR-5387.
